mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise and economic activity slows.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are positive in more than 40% of the instances when the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between FEDFUNDS increases and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% over two months indicates a strengthening demand in the housing market, which is a leading indicator of economic growth and thus positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 60% of the instances when the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between HOUST increases and positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% within a month signals an improving labor market, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer spending and confidence increase.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 60% of the instances when the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between UNRATE decreases and positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over two months signals an increase in economic output, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings improve.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 60% of the instances when the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between INDPRO increases and positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low inflation environment, indicated by CPIAUCSL remaining below 2% for three consecutive months, suggests a stable economic environment, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 60% of the instances when the CPIAUCSL is below 2% for three consecutive months, or if the correlation between low inflation and positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) increase by more than 1% month-over-month and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.3% over the same period, it signals a strengthening economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increases > 1% MoM AND UNRATE decreases > 0.3% MoM
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 60% of the instances when both trigger conditions are met, or if the joint effect of RSAFS and UNRATE on returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 over a month signals strong job growth, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as market sentiment improves.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 60% of the instances when the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between PAYEMS increases and positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) decreases by more than 2% over three months and GDP (GDPC1) growth is negative over the same period, it signals an economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO decreases > 2% in 3 months AND GDPC1 growth is negative
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are positive in more than 40% of the instances when both trigger conditions are met, or if the joint effect of INDPRO and GDPC1 on returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).
